fields: L4 Beijing / Chinese New Year (tricycle; Shichahai hutong → Chang'an Avenue → Summer Palace). Same item fields as L3 v3.1. Pools keep L3 names so pickSetL2 + l3TypeUniq can be reused: seawall = Lantern Riddle Stand 灯谜摊 questions (3–4 choices, timed 30 s; also the retry pool), forest_fork = Chang'an Avenue fork signs (≤3 choices; sign_en/sign_zh; EN ≤24 chars, ZH width ≤12), peak_final = Seventeen-Arch Bridge final 十七孔桥终极题 (exactly 4 choices, hard, situational). Per run: 5 riddle-stand + 4 fork + 1 final = 10. Every item has qtype + qtype_zh (each qtype at most once per run). {name} = player name; English on top, Chinese below. No subject capybara/beaver. Lantern riddles are object/animal riddles solvable in both languages (subject 'riddle'). Stems are deduped against all L1–L3 banks (all grades).

questions.q_en: Lantern riddle: My two hands meet at the top at midnight on New Year's Eve, and everyone shouts "Happy New Year!" What am I?
questions.q_zh: 灯谜：除夕半夜两只手在顶上相会，大家一起喊“过年好”。打一物，是什么？
questions.explain_en: At 12:00 midnight a clock's hands meet at the top.
questions.explain_zh: 半夜 12 点，钟的时针分针在顶上重合。

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: A pigeon flock of 7 grows by a factor of 2 every year. How many pigeons after 3 years?
questions.q_zh: 一群鸽子原有 7 只，每年变成原来的 2 倍，3 年后有多少只？
questions.qtype_zh: 指数增长/衰减求值（翻倍、等比）

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: A tricycle tour costs C = 2 + 2k yuan for k km. What is C when k = 9?
questions.q_zh: 三轮车游胡同的价钱是 C = 2 + 2k 元（k 为千米数），k = 9 时 C 是多少？

questions.subject: spring_festival
questions.q_en: A gate near the bridge shows the first line 向阳门第春常在. Which second line completes the couplet?
questions.q_zh: 桥边一扇门上的上联是「向阳门第春常在」。哪一句是它的下联？
questions.explain_en: 向阳门第春常在 / 积善人家庆有余: seven characters each, ending oblique then level.
questions.explain_zh: 向阳门第春常在，积善人家庆有余；各七字，上仄下平。
questions.qtype_zh: 春联知识（对仗/平仄/横批）

questions.subject: science
questions.q_en: Over Kunming Lake, Flora sees a bright green firework burst. Which metal's compounds most likely made it green?
questions.q_zh: Flora 看见昆明湖上空炸开一朵亮绿色的烟花。最可能是哪种金属的化合物让它变绿？
questions.explain_en: Barium salts give green; sodium yellow, strontium red, calcium orange.
questions.explain_zh: 钡呈绿色；钠黄、锶红、钙橙。

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: A firework over Kunming Lake rises with height h = -t² + 15t (in tens of metres). What is h at t = 2?
questions.q_zh: 昆明湖上空一枚烟花的高度是 h = -t² + 15t（单位：十米），t = 2 时 h 是多少？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: Two lantern sellers at the bridge: one charges 16 + 4x yuan, the other 20 + 2x yuan for x lanterns. For what x do they cost the same?
questions.q_zh: 桥边两家卖灯笼：一家 x 盏收 16 + 4x 元，另一家收 20 + 2x 元。x 是多少时两家价钱一样？
questions.qtype_zh: 两边都有未知数的方程

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: Lanterns are lit in waves on the bridge: 8 at first, and the number lit multiplies by 2 each wave. How many are lit in wave 6, after 5 multiplications?
questions.q_zh: 桥上灯笼一波波点亮：开始 8 盏，每一波是上一波的 2 倍。乘了 5 次之后（第 6 波）点亮多少盏？
questions.qtype_zh: 指数增长/衰减求值（翻倍、等比）

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: On a park grid (units of 10 m), the Seventeen-Arch Bridge's east end is at (0, 5) and Flora's tricycle is at (6, 13). What is the straight-line distance in grid units?
questions.q_zh: 在公园坐标图上（单位 10 米），十七孔桥东头在 (0, 5)，Flora 的三轮车在 (6, 13)，两点直线距离是几个单位？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: From the foot of a lantern pole on the bridge, a string runs to a point 12 m along the deck; the pole is 5 m tall. How long is the string from the top of the pole, in metres?
questions.q_zh: 桥上一根灯杆高 5 米，从杆顶拉一根彩绳到桥面上离杆脚 12 米的地方，绳长多少米？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: Last year 1200 lanterns lit the Seventeen-Arch Bridge. This year there are 5% more. How many lanterns are there this year?
questions.q_zh: 去年十七孔桥上亮了 1200 盏灯笼，今年多了 5%，今年有多少盏？
